title: Plumeform layout picker and bento band
description: A near-black green band: wide bold heading and copy, then a glass list of layouts (icon, name, tier word) beside a preview card that swaps in with a quick fade-rise when you pick one, then a bento of a giant mint-gradient number, a card of three-stripe colour swatches and three short notes with mint capitals.
notes: forces dark colours; swatches take theme colour names so they re-theme
each layout's preview is a media slot (placeholder when empty)
needs JavaScript for the picker; static HTML shows the first layout
name: plumeform-looks

props.name: layouts
props.description: the list on the left; choosing one swaps the preview card

props.name: stat
props.type: { label: string; value: string; text: ReactNode; }
props.description: the big-number card: a small label, the number, a line of text

props.name: themes
props.type: { title: string; text: ReactNode; swatches: { name: string; colours: PlumeformSwatchColour[]; }[]; }
props.description: the wide card: a title, text and named colour swatches

props.name: notes
props.description: short cards in a row: mint capitals and a sentence

props.name: backdrop
props.description: art behind the band (the original's WebGL fluted glass); empty shows a soft glow
